name: Diandao Zhiguai
source:
Demons and spirits run rampant in the mortal realm, yet the age-old tales of the grotesque have long silenced vibrant female voices. They wait for salvation, shatter over unfaithful lovers, remain earthbound by doomed passions... But what if heaven and earth reversed? Would the stories unfold differently?

Upside Down Tales of the Grotesque is a ​female-oriented classical AVG​ that subverts legendary folklore and flips gender roles, dismantling narratives that confine women to passivity. Here, she holds the brush, she wields the sword, and she shatters the chains of fate. Through the eyes of heroines, you'll step into this phantasmagorical world and live their epic tales of love, vengeance, and adventure—all authored by their own hands.

[Edited from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3983190/Upside_Down_Tales_of_the_Grotesque/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
红尘之中妖魔精怪横行肆虐，然而千百年来的志怪传奇，却长久湮没了鲜活的女性声音。她们苦候救赎，为薄情郎君肝肠寸断，困于注定无果的痴情执念而画地为牢……可若是乾坤颠倒、阴阳逆转，故事又会迎来怎样的展开？

《颠倒志怪》是一款颠覆传统民间传说、逆转男女角色定位的女性向古风志怪AVG，打破了将女性禁锢于被动地位的陈旧叙事。在这里，她执笔，她仗剑，她亲手斩断命运的枷锁。透过女主角们的双眼，你将踏入这片奇谲瑰丽的志怪世界，亲历她们由自己执笔书写的爱恨、复仇与传奇冒险。

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3983190/Upside_Down_Tales_of_the_Grotesque/]Steam[/url]（经编辑）]
